description: Registered OpenDDE run stores for the held-out do-not-run audit (scripts/qualification/run_audit.py; plan revision 75 onward). Register every new store here before its first run; this file lives outside scripts/qualification, so registering a store is not a contract amendment. Paths are on gnode2 unless stated.

stores.note: Step 0 baselines, calibration, controls, smoke tests for contracts 1-5 (2026-10-10 to 2026-10-12). Many early runs predate run records; their seeds come from the output layout and their inputs only from job names.
Porting checkout; searched for ad hoc output directories (none found on 2026-10-14).
Job scripts and logs; searched for ad hoc output directories (none found on 2026-10-14).
Pre-tag contract-6 GPU provenance check (job 50623): D1, D4 and D5 at development seed 101, reduced recipe.

A100 stock step 0 and calibration (user go-ahead 2026-10-14): development rows D1-D15 and repository examples only, development seeds 101 and 102; outputs under runs/, job scripts under jobs/, logs under logs/. The VM is ephemeral; its outputs, logs and tier 1 captures are copied to /mnt/compbio-data/yang.su/opendde-a100/2026-10-14 on gnode2.

stores.note: Copies of the A100 VM runs, logs and tier 1 captures; verification coverage and relocation map are in porting_docs/qualification_records/storage_relocation_2026-10-16.json. Most relays were checked against streamed VM-side sha256 lists, which were not kept. runs/step0/ab-43, runs/step0/cpu-42 and runs/smoke-41 were never checksum-checked against the VM; only their intermediate /data-to-NAS move was verified, and that manifest was not kept. The VM is retired and these historical provenance gaps remain unresolved. Setup recipe and job scripts are in ~/opendde-dev-checks/a100 (README.md); the initial /data-to-NAS move was user-approved on 2026-10-14.

Bulk porting outputs that are not qualification evidence (user decision 2026-10-14; README.md there). sm120-captures/ holds copies of the sm_120 tier 1 capture directories from opendde-step0 and opendde-standin under the same relative paths, with source sha256 manifests in sm120-captures/MANIFESTS.

Dedicated sm_120 acceptance checkout (decision 2026-10-11), a clone of the approved fork created 2026-10-17 at the first fast candidate's code commit 25267ec; runs and measurements write outside it. Searched for ad hoc output directories before use.

First fast candidate (25267ec, --optimization_mode fast): the paired D1/D9 candidate smoke test (smoke/) and the D1-D15 development evidence and rehearsal record (rehearsal-1/). Development rows and development seeds 101 and 102 only.

Archive copies of closed acceptance lines, one directory per line with its source manifests (accept-sm120-fast-25267ec: rejected, 2026-10-17). Copies, not new runs; originals stay in their registered stores until the storage-admin procedure protects the archive.
